## Lifecycle checklist

- [ ] **Plan** — grilled the approach (`grilling` / `grill-with-docs`) before coding
- [ ] **Spec/Tickets** — plan carried into a spec (`to-spec`, small / single-agent) OR tickets (`to-tickets`, bigger / parallelized across agents)
- [ ] **TDD** — implemented (`implement`) with adversarial `test-driven-development` (tests added/updated)
- [ ] **Review** — self / peer `code-review` pass done
- [ ] **Validate** — ran the suite + manual/functional check; green
<!-- coding-gate:checklist:end -->
